User.title: User Profile
User.description: User's individual profile data including personal details and study goals.

isManager.description: Flag indicating if the user has Manager access

coins.description: User's current coin balance, defaults to 50 for normal users

unlimitedExpirity.description: Timestamp in ms for unlimited pass

CurrentAffair.title: Saved Current Affair
CurrentAffair.description: Individual news item or current affair fact saved by a user.

QuizHistoryItem.title: Quiz History Item
QuizHistoryItem.description: Record of a quiz taken by the user

SavedNote.title: Saved Note
SavedNote.description: Smart notes generated and saved by the user

SupportMessage.title: Support Chat Message
SupportMessage.description: A message sent either by the user or the manager in the support chat.

GlobalSetting.title: Global Application Setting
GlobalSetting.description: Global configuration parameters for the application.

pricePerCoin.description: Price of a single coin in INR

unlimitedPassPrice.description: Price for unlimited pass in INR

unlimitedPassDays.description: Duration of unlimited pass in days

Notification.title: Global Notification
Notification.description: A notification broadcasted by the manager to all users.

PaymentRequest.title: Payment Request
PaymentRequest.description: A payment verification request created by a user after paying via QR, requiring manager's approval.

paymentRequests/{requestId}.description: Collection of manual payment recharge verification requests submitted by users with their transaction UTR.

notifications/{notificationId}.description: Collection of global notifications/alerts sent by manager.

users/{userId}.description: Collection of user profiles keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.

users/{userId}/savedAffairs/{affairId}.description: Collection of current affairs saved by the user.

users/{userId}/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Collection of quizzes taken by the user.

users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Collection of smart notes saved by the user.

users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time support chat messages between the user and manager.
